rationale: Held unchanged for the 2-day out-of-sample test before the Wed-Fri Team->Primary decision (owner 2026-11-09): same 7 setups, same weights, same Primary rule set as the 11-09 pick; nothing added, nothing dropped (all 7 ids still exist in config and none showed a data or sizing bug on 11-09).
Out-of-sample day 1 (11-09): Team +2.54R / +$433.50 after costs (14 trades, 10 wins) vs Primary -18.10R (+20.64R). Longs +4.05R, shorts -1.51R. One session - one draw.

Concern - thin records: CWT09 (15 live trades), NM-ETF late dip (15 + 2), GEN-261027-01 (10 + 7; generated, weak 2-year screen) and NS5 (w/o best day about zero, 1-day tag) are low-rep; ST7 also carries a 1-day tag (best session 68% of R). Most of the 11-09 gain came from GEN-261027-01 (+2.06R, 7 trades) and NM-ETF (+0.99R) - low-rep setups doing the work is a fragility, not proof.

Concern - sizing: Gap-Down VWAP Loss Short (10% gap) / CWT09 is sized at $250 per R in its Live Lab home, so its live-dollar record is not comparable to Primary's 0.25% risk; the Team sizes it at Primary's rule. On 11-09 it had 9 signals and 0 Team trades - check whether that is a filter/sizing block before the decision. Separately, the ~$4k Primary lot cap makes risk dollars per trade uneven (11-09 RW5: UVXY ~$114 at risk vs TCOM/ACGL ~$29), so equal R can mean very unequal dollars (RW5 -1.22R but +$45.60).

Concern - family/side balance: 3 shorts / 4 longs, but two shorts are sister RW gap-down pop-fade rules (RW3/RW5, overlap resolved by setup order) and carry most expected R on the long-run record, while day 1 was carried by the late longs (GEN + NM-ETF, both 14:00-15:00, both long). Short side was -1.51R on 11-09 (RW3 -0.29R, RW5 -1.22R). A one-sided or late-window-heavy book could swing hard on a trend-down afternoon.

Method unchanged from 11-09 (live R after costs pooled across homes, w/o best day, best-day share, ex-market R and beta, last-5, green rate; 2-year lists as tie-breakers). No new ranking was run for this pick, so no new configurations were tried.
